zh: 核合成在大爆炸后 §0§ s（$T = §1§$ MeV）；n/p 在 $T\approx§2§$ MeV 开始冻结，中子寿命 $\tau_n = §3§。半解析，阈值按标准模型校准
en: Nucleosynthesis §0§ s after the big bang ($T = §1§$ MeV); n/p starts freezing out at $T\approx§2§$ MeV, neutron lifetime $\tau_n = §3§. Semi-analytic, threshold calibrated to the standard model

zh: ；$\eta$ 太小，真实的核反应会跟不上膨胀
en: ; $\eta$ too small, real nuclear reactions could not keep up with the expansion
$\eta = §0§$, outside the trusted range of the fit ($\eta_{10}\approx0.5$–$30$)

zh: 量子反弹时温度只有 §0§ K，从没热到 10 MeV
en: At the quantum bounce the temperature was only §0§ K, never hot enough to reach 10 MeV

zh: 没有辐射就没有热的早期
en: no radiation, so no hot early phase

zh: 反弹时温度 §0§ K，低于氢的复合温度：氢（如果有）从一开始就是中性的
en: At the bounce the temperature was §0§ K, below hydrogen's recombination temperature: hydrogen (if any) was neutral from the start

zh: 重子太稀（η = §0§）：电子还全在时散射率就已低于膨胀率，光子早早自由§1§；复合（Saha 50%）在 z ≈ §2§
en: Baryons too sparse (η = §0§): the scattering rate dropped below the expansion rate while all the electrons were still free, so the photons were freed early§1§; recombination (Saha 50%) at z ≈ §2§

zh: ——退耦定在正负电子湮灭时（T ≈ 0.17 MeV），再早的散射来自 e± 对等离子体
en: — decoupling is placed at e⁺e⁻ annihilation (T ≈ 0.17 MeV); earlier scattering came from the e± pair plasma

zh: Saha 平衡近似（比完整计算早约 4%）；那时电离度 x_e = §0§，温度 §1§ K，电离能 §2§ eV
en: Saha-equilibrium approximation (about 4% earlier than the full calculation); ionization fraction then x_e = §0§, temperature §1§ K, ionization energy §2§ eV

zh: 汤姆孙散射率到今天仍高于膨胀率：宇宙一直不透明
en: the Thomson scattering rate still exceeds the expansion rate today: the universe has always been opaque

zh: 反推台用的那把"标准尺"，这里是算出来的（我们的宇宙 147 Mpc；Saha 近似略小）
en: the "standard ruler" used on the inference bench, computed here (147 Mpc in our universe; slightly smaller in the Saha approximation)

zh: 由 $A_s = §0§$、$r = §1§$：$H_{\mathrm{inf}} = §2§$ GeV，$\epsilon = §3§$，慢滚 $\eta = §4§$（大统一能标量级 $10^{16}$ GeV）
en: From $A_s = §0§$ and $r = §1§$: $H_{\mathrm{inf}} = §2§$ GeV, $\epsilon = §3§$, slow-roll $\eta = §4§$ (of order the grand-unification scale $10^{16}$ GeV)

zh: 每个哈勃时间 $H/2\pi$；德西特温度 $T_{GH} = §0§$ K；§1§ 个 e-fold 用时 $§2§$ s
en: $H/2\pi$ per Hubble time; de Sitter temperature $T_{GH} = §0§$ K; §1§ e-folds take $§2§$ s

zh: 永远加速的宇宙最终只剩这个温度的热辐射（Gibbons–Hawking）：$T = \hbar H_\infty/2\pi k_B$
en: An ever-accelerating universe ends with nothing but thermal radiation at this temperature (Gibbons–Hawking): $T = \hbar H_\infty/2\pi k_B$

zh: 反弹在 §0§前；那时密度 $\rho_c = 10^{§1§}\rho_{\mathrm{crit}}$，温度 $§2§$ K
en: The bounce was §0§ ago; density then $\rho_c = 10^{§1§}\rho_{\mathrm{crit}}$, temperature $§2§$ K

zh: 没有氢就没有水、没有有机化学；恒星从氦直接烧起，寿命短得多。
en: Without hydrogen there is no water and no organic chemistry; stars burn helium from the start and live far shorter lives.
Primordial helium §0§%: on the high side

zh: 氢还够用，但类太阳恒星更亮、寿命更短。
en: There is still enough hydrogen, but Sun-like stars are brighter and shorter-lived.

zh: 几乎没有原初氦——恒星照常，氦由恒星自己造。
en: Almost no primordial helium — stars work as usual and make their own helium.

zh: 和我们的宇宙一样，四分之一的重子进了氦。
en: As in our universe, a quarter of the baryons went into helium.

zh: $Q = §0§$ MeV 小于电子质量 $m_e = 0.511$ MeV：中子不再衰变，反而是质子俘获电子变成中子（$p + e^- \to n + \nu_e$）。没有稳定的氢，也就没有化学。
en: $Q = §0§$ MeV is less than the electron mass $m_e = 0.511$ MeV: neutrons no longer decay; instead protons capture electrons and become neutrons ($p + e^- \to n + \nu_e$). No stable hydrogen, hence no chemistry.

zh: 电子一直自由，光子一直被散射：没有 CMB，重子也被辐射压拖着无法坍缩。
en: The electrons stay free and the photons keep scattering: no CMB, and the baryons are dragged by radiation pressure and cannot collapse.

zh: 重子太稀，光子在复合之前就已经自由飞行；复合本身照常发生。
en: Baryons too sparse: the photons were already flying freely before recombination; recombination itself happens as usual.

zh: 复合晚于第一批星系的坍缩时刻
en: Recombination comes after the first galaxies would collapse

zh: 重子在那之前还和光子绑在一起，星系形成要等到复合之后才真正开始。
en: Until then the baryons are still tied to the photons; galaxy formation only really starts after recombination.

zh: 之后光子自由飞行，重子可以落进暗物质的势阱。
en: Afterwards the photons fly freely and the baryons can fall into the dark-matter potential wells.

zh: 创世台上 $T_0 = 0$：没有热的早期，这个展区没什么可放的。把 $T_0$ 拨上去。
en: On the Forge $T_0 = 0$: there is no hot early phase, so this hall has nothing to show. Turn $T_0$ up.

zh: 反弹太冷，没有热的早期
en: The bounce is too cold; no hot early phase

zh: 圈量子宇宙学的反弹密度被拉得太低：反弹时温度只有 $§0§$ K，连氢的复合温度都不到，更没有核合成和粒子汤。把创世台上的 $\rho_c$ 拉高（真实理论值在最右端），这里才有东西可放。
en: The bounce density of loop quantum cosmology has been pulled too low: at the bounce the temperature is only $§0§$ K, below even hydrogen's recombination temperature, let alone nucleosynthesis or a particle soup. Raise $\rho_c$ on the Forge (the real theoretical value is at the far right) and this hall has something to show.

zh: 这是圈量子宇宙学的宇宙：没有奇点，也没有暴胀。在这之前是一个收缩中的前宇宙，密度在反弹时达到 $\rho_c$，温度 $§0§$ K。
en: This is a loop-quantum-cosmology universe: no singularity and no inflation. Before this there was a contracting pre-universe whose density reached $\rho_c$ at the bounce, at a temperature of $§0§$ K.

zh: 量子引力的领地：这里没有可信的方程。经典时空、甚至"时间"本身都未必有意义。
en: The realm of quantum gravity: no trustworthy equations here. Classical spacetime, even "time" itself, need not mean anything.

zh: 不知道。标准模型只从暴胀开始讲起；更早的事（量子引力、暴胀子怎么来的）是开放问题。
en: Unknown. The standard story only starts with inflation; what came earlier (quantum gravity, where the inflaton came from) is an open question.

zh: 暴胀子的势能像宇宙学常数一样驱动 $a\propto e^{Ht}$，$H = §0§$ GeV。已经膨胀了 §1§ 个 e-fold（共 §2§）。德西特温度 $§3§$ K 下，场每个哈勃时间长出 $\delta\phi = H/2\pi$ 的量子涨落，被拉出视界后冻结——这些就是将来星系的种子，功率 $A_s = §4§$。
en: The inflaton's potential energy drives $a\propto e^{Ht}$ like a cosmological constant, with $H = §0§$ GeV. §1§ e-folds so far (of §2§). At the de Sitter temperature $§3§$ K the field grows a quantum fluctuation $\delta\phi = H/2\pi$ every Hubble time, which freezes once stretched outside the horizon — these are the future seeds of galaxies, with power $A_s = §4§$.
The particle soup after the bounce

zh: §0§，温度 §1§。所有标准模型粒子都是相对论性的，§2§。希格斯场还没凝结，一切粒子无质量。
en: §0§, temperature §1§. All standard-model particles are relativistic, §2§. The Higgs field has not condensed yet; every particle is massless.

zh: 反弹把收缩的能量全部交给辐射
en: The bounce hands all the energy of the contraction to radiation

zh: 辐射时期：等待电弱相变
en: Radiation era: waiting for the electroweak transition

zh: 温度 §0§，$a\propto t^{1/2}$，哈勃半径 §1§，里面只有 §2§。粒子汤的成分在这 §3§ 个数量级里几乎不变（§4§）。重子不对称（每十亿对正反粒子多出一个重子）在这段的某处产生，机制未知——标准模型的 CP 破坏不够。
en: Temperature §0§, $a\propto t^{1/2}$, Hubble radius §1§, containing only §2§. Over these §3§ orders of magnitude the content of the soup hardly changes (§4§). The baryon asymmetry (one extra baryon per billion particle–antiparticle pairs) arises somewhere in this stretch, by an unknown mechanism — the CP violation of the standard model is not enough.
The eve of the electroweak transition

zh: 温度 §0§，离希格斯场凝结（$T\approx160$ GeV）不远。顶夸克、W、Z 还都是无质量的相对论性粒子，§1§。
en: Temperature §0§, not far from the condensation of the Higgs field ($T\approx160$ GeV). The top quark, W and Z are still massless relativistic particles, §1§.

zh: 希格斯场凝结（$T\approx160$ GeV），W、Z、顶夸克获得质量并陆续湮灭。夸克和胶子仍是自由的等离子体，§0§。
en: The Higgs field has condensed ($T\approx160$ GeV); W, Z and the top quark acquire mass and annihilate one after another. Quarks and gluons are still a free plasma, §0§.

zh: 夸克在 $T\approx150$ MeV 被禁闭进质子、中子和介子；介子、μ 子随温度下降湮灭。§0§。n/p 还在弱作用平衡：$n/p = e^{-Q/T} = §1§$。
en: At $T\approx150$ MeV the quarks are confined into protons, neutrons and mesons; mesons and muons annihilate as the temperature falls. §0§. n/p is still in weak equilibrium: $n/p = e^{-Q/T} = §1§$.

zh: 弱作用率 $\propto G_F^2T^5$ 追不上膨胀率 $\propto T^2/M_{Pl}$。中微子在 $T\approx§0§$ MeV 退耦；n/p 在 $T\approx§1§$ MeV 开始离开平衡，到 $T\approx§2§$ MeV 冻透在 ≈ §3§§4§，之后只能靠衰变（$\tau_n = §5§$ s）慢慢减少。
en: The weak rate $\propto G_F^2T^5$ can no longer keep up with the expansion rate $\propto T^2/M_{Pl}$. Neutrinos decouple at $T\approx§0§$ MeV; n/p starts leaving equilibrium at $T\approx§1§$ MeV and is fully frozen at ≈ §3§ by $T\approx§2§$ MeV§4§; after that it can only decrease slowly by decay ($\tau_n = §5§$ s).

zh: e⁺e⁻ 湮灭把光子加热到比中微子高 $(11/4)^{1/3}$ 倍。氘的结合能 $B_D = §0§$ MeV，但每个重子配 $§1§$ 个光子，高能尾巴不断把氘打碎；中子在等待中衰变：$X_n = §2§$。
en: e⁺e⁻ annihilation heats the photons to $(11/4)^{1/3}$ times the neutrino temperature. The binding energy of deuterium is $B_D = §0§$ MeV, but there are $§1§$ photons per baryon and the high-energy tail keeps breaking deuterium apart; the neutrons decay while waiting: $X_n = §2§$.

zh: $T\approx§0§$ MeV 时氘存活，几分钟内几乎所有中子进了 ⁴He：$Y_p = §1§\%$，$\mathrm{D/H}\approx§2§$。此后几十万年是光子和等离子体的世界。
en: At $T\approx§0§$ MeV deuterium survives, and within minutes almost all neutrons end up in ⁴He: $Y_p = §1§\%$, $\mathrm{D/H}\approx§2§$. The next few hundred thousand years belong to photons and plasma.

zh: 电离度 $x_e = §0§$；电离能 $B = §1§$ eV，但复合要等到 $T\sim B/50 \approx §2§$ eV——光子太多了。
en: Ionization fraction $x_e = §0§$; ionization energy $B = §1§$ eV, but recombination has to wait until $T\sim B/50 \approx §2§$ eV — there are too many photons.

zh: 温度 $§0§$ K。质子和电子正在结合成氢原子（$x_e = §1§$），但剩下的自由电子还够把光子散射住；要等 $n_e\sigma_T c$ 掉到 $H$ 以下（$z\approx§2§$）光子才退耦。
en: Temperature $§0§$ K. Protons and electrons are combining into hydrogen atoms ($x_e = §1§$), but the remaining free electrons are still enough to keep the photons scattering; the photons decouple only when $n_e\sigma_T c$ drops below $H$ ($z\approx§2§$).

zh: 温度 $§0§$ K，核合成已经结束，辐射的能量密度仍大于物质（物质-辐射相等要到 $a\approx§1§$）。光子被自由电子不断散射，重子被辐射压拖住。
en: Temperature $§0§$ K; nucleosynthesis is over, but the energy density of radiation still exceeds that of matter (matter–radiation equality comes at $a\approx§1§$). The photons are constantly scattered by free electrons, and the baryons are held back by radiation pressure.

zh: 温度 $§0§$ K，物质已经压过辐射，暗物质的势阱开始加深，但重子还被光子拖着跑不进去。光子被自由电子不断散射。
en: Temperature $§0§$ K; matter has overtaken radiation and the dark-matter potential wells are deepening, but the baryons are still dragged by the photons and cannot fall in. The photons are constantly scattered by free electrons.

zh: 复合之后：光子自由飞行
电子被束缚进氢原子，汤姆孙散射率 $n_e\sigma_T c$ 掉到膨胀率 $H$ 以下：这一刻的光就是今天的 CMB。重子开始落进暗物质的势阱，黑暗时代开始。
en: The electrons are bound into hydrogen atoms and the Thomson scattering rate $n_e\sigma_T c$ drops below the expansion rate $H$: the light of this moment is today's CMB. The baryons begin to fall into the dark-matter potential wells; the dark ages begin.

zh: 宇宙是今天的 $§0§$ 倍大
en: the universe is $§0§$ times its size today

zh: 中微子比光子冷：e⁺e⁻ 只加热了光子
en: neutrinos colder than photons: e⁺e⁻ heated only the photons
relative to the end of inflation $a = §0§$

zh: 虚线是弱作用平衡 $X_n^{eq} = 1/(1 + e^{Q/T})$；实线离开它就是冻结。$Y_p = 2X_n(\text{氘瓶颈}) = §0§\%$。
en: The dashed line is weak equilibrium $X_n^{eq} = 1/(1 + e^{Q/T})$; where the solid line leaves it is freeze-out. $Y_p = 2X_n(\text{deuterium bottleneck}) = §0§\%$.

zh: 退耦在 $z = §0§$（Saha 近似）；电离能 $B = §1§$ eV，$\eta = §2§$。
en: Decoupling at $z = §0§$ (Saha approximation); ionization energy $B = §1§$ eV, $\eta = §2§$.

zh: 汤姆孙散射率至今高于膨胀率：没有退耦。
en: The Thomson scattering rate still exceeds the expansion rate today: no decoupling.

zh: 波长 > 视界：冻结成经典扰动
en: wavelength > horizon: frozen into a classical perturbation

zh: 波长 < 视界：还是量子涨落
en: wavelength < horizon: still a quantum fluctuation

zh: 量子涨落 δφ = H/2π 的模式，每个哈勃时间被拉长 e 倍
en: modes of the quantum fluctuation δφ = H/2π, stretched by a factor e every Hubble time

zh: 普朗克时期：没有可信的图像
反弹之前：收缩中的前宇宙
en: Before the bounce: a contracting pre-universe
Bounce too cold: no particle soup

zh: 白：质子；灰：中子（已冻结，只剩衰变）
en: white: protons; grey: neutrons (frozen out, only decaying)

zh: 白：质子；灰：中子（正在冻结）
白：质子；灰：中子（弱作用平衡，Γ/H = §0§）
en: white: protons; grey: neutrons (weak equilibrium, Γ/H = §0§)

zh: 核合成进行中：中子找质子成氘，氘再成 ⁴He
en: Nucleosynthesis in progress: neutrons find protons to make deuterium, deuterium makes ⁴He

zh: 白：质子；青：束缚电子（§0§/§1§ 个氢原子已复合）；金圈：⁴He × §2§
en: white: protons; teal: bound electrons (§0§/§1§ hydrogen atoms recombined); gold rings: ⁴He × §2§

zh: 白：质子 × §0§；金圈：⁴He × §1§（Y_p = §2§% 是质量份额：40 个核子里约 §3§ 个进了 ⁴He）
en: white: protons × §0§; gold rings: ⁴He × §1§ (Y_p = §2§% is a mass fraction: about §3§ of 40 nucleons went into ⁴He)
photons fly in straight lines: decoupled

zh: 光子被自由电子散射：γ + e⁻ → γ + e⁻
en: photons scattered by free electrons: γ + e⁻ → γ + e⁻

zh: 彩点：相对论性粒子，按能量份额
en: colored dots: relativistic particles, by energy share

zh: 禁闭：q q q → p, n
en: confinement: q q q → p, n

zh: 没有辐射，也就没有光子-重子流体
en: No radiation, hence no photon–baryon fluid

zh: 反弹太冷：没有等离子体
退耦太早：光子-重子流体没形成过
en: Decoupled too early: the photon–baryon fluid never formed

zh: 暴胀期：涨落还在被拉出视界
en: During inflation: the fluctuations are still being stretched outside the horizon

zh: 再加热之后，这里会把一个原初涨落放大：看光子-重子流体怎么跑出一个球壳，一直长到 r_s
en: After reheating, this panel magnifies one primordial fluctuation: watch the photon–baryon fluid run out as a spherical shell and grow all the way to r_s

zh: ；退耦后重子不再被光子推，声波停了
en: ; after decoupling the baryons are no longer pushed by the photons and the sound wave stops

zh: 退耦后声波停了：这就是声学视界
en: the sound wave stopped at decoupling: this is the sound horizon

zh: 这个宇宙至今没有退耦，壳还在长
en: this universe has not decoupled yet; the shell is still growing

zh: 自由流动，把壳的记忆带到今天的 CMB 上
en: free-streaming, carrying the memory of the shell to today's CMB
$\ell_A = \pi/\theta_* = §0§$; the first peak is at about $0.73\,\ell_A \approx §1§$

zh: 退耦后光子自由飞行，带着壳的印记成为 CMB 的声学峰；重子壳留在原地，后来和中心的暗物质互相吸引——今天星系的两点关联函数在 $r_s$ 处有一个小峰（重子声学振荡）。
en: After decoupling the photons fly freely, carrying the imprint of the shell into the acoustic peaks of the CMB; the baryon shell stays where it is and later attracts, and is attracted by, the dark matter at the center — today's galaxy two-point correlation function has a small bump at $r_s$ (baryon acoustic oscillations).

zh: 一个原初涨落：暗物质留在中心，光子-重子流体被辐射压推成一个球壳向外跑，声速 $c_s = c/\sqrt{3(1+R)}$——重子越多（$R$ 越大）跑得越慢。壳走过的共动距离就是 $r_s$。
en: One primordial fluctuation: the dark matter stays at the center, while the photon–baryon fluid is pushed outward by radiation pressure as a spherical shell at the sound speed $c_s = c/\sqrt{3(1+R)}$ — the more baryons (the larger $R$), the slower it runs. The comoving distance the shell travels is $r_s$.

zh: 放到头了，从暴胀开始重放
en: Reached the end; replaying from inflation

zh: 已到最后一个事件，回到开头
en: Already at the last event; back to the start
